long_description.before:
Going global is now the norm. But the moment you set up an entity in another country, you inherit a tax and legal mess that compounds with every hire and every invoice. 

For example, one jurisdiction has to be profitable, cash has to move between entities compliantly, and every cross-border decision has to be audit-ready, which today means a different law firm in each country, a tax advisor on top of that, and you coordinating the chaos.

The real expertise is locked up inside the Big Four. The world's largest companies pay millions a year for access. Everyone else gets selective coverage and hefty legal bills to half-solve the problem.

Caribou is the first autonomous tax firm. No lengthy workshops, no months of back-and-fort; connect your finance and HR systems and we graph your business — every entity, process, and employee — into a model we call the Atlas. 

From there we check transfer pricing, surface legal risks you didn't know you had, maximise your R&D credits, and monitor for accidental taxes as your shape changes.

And we don't just hand you a report. We speak to your accountants, draft the legal agreements, and implement the fix ourselves. We've turned an 
eight-week engagement into three hours.

Why work with three firms when one does the job?

We're already working with fast-growing companies like Butternut Box, OpenFX, Encord, Vertice, Omnea, and Hadrian - we've saved them hundreds of thousands on legal fees and surprise tax bills.
long_description.after:
Caribou is transfer pricing software with the experts built in, for multi-entity companies expanding across borders, usually 2 to 10 entities with a UK or US parent and subsidiaries abroad. Software does the work and our tax experts own the outcome: we design the group's transfer pricing, draft the intercompany agreements, benchmark the pricing, post the accounting entries, and write the Local and Master Files and  then keep it all current as the group grows.

We also look across VAT, permanent establishment, withholding tax and R&D eligibility, and we've launched UK R&D tax relief claims. One team and one subscription, with questions during the year included instead of a Big Four project every couple of years. Butternut Box, Duffel, Hadrian, OpenFX, Solve Intelligence, Vertice, Omnea, and Encord work with us.

one_liner.before: The autonomous tax firm
one_liner.after: Transfer pricing software with the experts built in

Elimentary’s is building AI agents that can run middle/back-office operations for private capital managers, starting with structured credit. Most private capital managers focus primarily on sourcing and capital deployment. Meanwhile post-investment operations receive step-child treatment. While AUMs have increased exponentially over the last decade, operations continue to be painfully supported by humans using spreadsheets and emails. Things have started to break leading to investment write-offs, fines, penalties, and sometimes lost LP relationships. 

Our agents can run these operations (borrowing base calcs, cracking loan tapes, NAV calculations, etc.) end to end autonomously. For one of our customers, our agents cut a 20-hour ops process to 30 minutes. It saved 90% of the manual hours, translating to $150k in annual savings.
long_description.after:
Elimentary automates the recurring middle and back office work of private credit funds.
Every month, fund teams receive loan files, credit agreements, bank statements and servicer reports. Analysts spend hours turning these documents into usable data, checking borrower obligations, reconciling accounts and preparing reports across spreadsheets and email.

Elimentary brings this work into a coordinated team of AI agents. They standardize loan data, monitor covenants, reconcile financial records and prepare reporting for investors, fund administrators and other stakeholders.

For example, our reconciliation agents compare bank records with the fund administrator’s records and prepare the reconciliation for the finance team to review. People retain final sign-off, helping funds handle more operational work without adding headcount at the same pace.

long_description.before:
Our mission is to give every AI agent the right context, from any amount of data.

WonderSearch is search built for AI agents. We let developers make all of their data searchable by meaning, without embeddings, servers or ingestion, so agents can pull the right context and cite where it came from. Unlike vector databases and RAG stacks, there's no pipeline to build or maintain: connect your files and data, and they're searchable right away. It runs on our own search model, and you pay only per query, whatever the size of your data.

Teams use WonderSearch across their own documents and knowledge, and build it into their products, help centres and AI features, connecting through MCP, our API, the CLI or the Python SDK.

(Evokoa, Inc. is the company behind WonderSearch.)
long_description.after:
Our mission is to rebuild the file system, the oldest idea in computing, for its newest users: AI agents.

FlashDrive is a shared drive for teams and their AI agents. You can use it via MCP or mount it like a normal folder on macOS and Linux, so your laptop, your teammates' and every sandbox work in the same live files at once. Agents hand off work through files: one writes, the next one reads.

That makes AI multiplayer across a whole company. Everyone keeps the agent they already like, whether that's Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or something custom, and there's no new app to learn. Your agents and your teammates' agents work in the same files and pick up where each other left off.

Shared drives were built for people. Agents work differently: many of them edit the same files at once. Unlike Dropbox or Google Drive, FlashDrive merges edits made at the same time, or keeps both, instead of creating a conflicted copy. Cloud sandboxes connect with no setup, huge files stream instead of filling the disk, and every file can be searched with keywords and grep.

(FlashDrive is by Evokoa, Inc.)

one_liner.before: Instant semantic search over your data without embeddings.
one_liner.after: A shared drive for your team and all your AI agents.

long_description.before:
Gather's long horizon agent serves enterprise GTM teams by continually interviewing real buyers and turning what it learned into content that drives pipeline and simulations that predict customer behavior.

More than 65 enterprise marketing teams, including Envoy, Eclypsium, Cover Genius, Fortinet, CoStar, Bagel Brands, and Family Express, use Gather to continually fight AI slop and create original on-brand, third-party validated thought leadership, reports, ebooks, and campaign content.

The value of that research compounds. Every interview adds to a foundation of quantitative, qualitative, and voice data from over 300,000 real interviews across customers, with thousands added monthly. Our models use that understanding to predict how buyers will respond to messaging, pricing, and market shifts. Each answer includes supporting evidence and a confidence level. When confidence is low, Gather automatically runs new research.

Gather starts by replacing research firms and content agencies, and we aspire to build the real-time customer understanding layer that enterprises will use to drive decisions.

Built by the team that created Cooliris (acquired by Yahoo) and Pulse (acquired by Gartner), and ran Gartner Peer Insights.
long_description.after:
Gather's AI agent for enterprise GTM continually interviews real buyers and turns those conversations into content that drives pipeline and simulations that predict customer behavior.

More than 65 enterprise marketing teams, including Envoy, Eclypsium, Cover Genius, Fortinet, CoStar, Bagel Brands, and Family Express, use Gather to create original, on-brand, third-party validated thought leadership, reports, ebooks, and campaign content.

That customer understanding compounds with every interview. Our models draw on quantitative, qualitative, and voice data from over 300,000 real interviews across customers, with thousands added monthly. Teams can simulate how buyers will respond to messaging, pricing, and market shifts, with supporting evidence and a confidence level behind every answer. When confidence is low, Gather automatically runs new research.

We’re starting by replacing research firms and content agencies. We’re building the intelligence enterprises and their agents need to understand and serve customers, whether human or AI.

Built by the team that created Cooliris (acquired by Yahoo) and Pulse (acquired by Gartner), and ran Gartner Peer Insights.
